avis.titre: Overall Okay but Use with Caution!
avis.texte: I typically use the Paula's Choice 2% Exfoliant each night with no issues. However, the first time I used the Rael triple acid exfoliant, it stung so badly after just a few seconds. I only kept it on for maybe one minute before I had to wash it off. I will say, though, it made a difference in my skin over the next day. So, the product seems decent, but is extremely strong. I also had tried to wait a couple of nights of not using my chemical exfoliants, so I wouldn't cause too much damage on my face. I would only consider using the Rael exfoliant every once in a while.

This is a great exfoliant! I have used it 3 times and saw a significant difference. I'm a skincare junkie and no stranger to acids/chemical exfoliants. This product worked great! There was no discomfort when I applied, but of course be careful not to use anything abrasive to wash your face prior to application or it could irritate the skin. I had no adverse reactions, just great results. I have spent upwards of 50-100 and maybe even more on products that do what this did for under 20 bucks! Just get it!

Real kindly gave me this Miracle Clear Brightening Triple Acid Exfoliant for free so that I could review it. I am familiar with using acids as exfoliators and I much prefer that method over physical exfoliators, so I do really love when I see an affordable option, which this is. I think this would be a great beginner acid exfoliator because, in my experience, it felt gentle on the skin, compared to others I have tried. I did notice that it helped in making my skin appear softer and more bright; however, I actually still had some dry patches after the 3 minute mask, so leaving it on for longer might be a better option for drier skin, like I have. I struggled with a rating because I believe this should really be a good 3 1/2 stars - it's a good exfoliant, and I would recommend it to someone who is just beginning to try chemical exfoliators or is seeking a gentler method of exfoliation, but I don't think it's the best I've tried. I also prefer to use wipes or cotton pads/liquid rather than a mask and I will more regularly use that over a mask. That being said, I will continue to use this product and would still recommend this to certain people that fit within certain parameters because I do think it is a pretty good product at a great price.

From the first use, I noticed a remarkable improvement in the texture and clarity of my skin. This exfoliant works to dissolve dead skin cells gently, unclog pores, and fade dark spots. Over time, my skin appears even-toned, smoother, and noticeably brighter.

It's a unique mix of hydration and exfoliation that I don't think exists! Using the power of AHA, BHA and PHA I feel hella get rid of dead skin and the layer of crud on my skin. It tinkles but after three minutes, my skin somehow feels hydrated and I don't even have to put on toner (but of course I do!)! I would buy this if you deal with breakouts but also need to stay hydrated.

avis.titre: Very potent. Be sure to wear sunscreen if going outside
avis.texte: This is very potent. I also have sensitive and combination skin. I suffer from dry patches. Instructions states to leave on as little as 3 mins to 10 mins. I opt to try for 5 minutes. It definitely gave me a tingling, slightly burning sensation. It got my face mostly smooth. I still had a few dry patches on my forehead. I did my normal skin care routine after with toner, serum and moisturizer. The next day I went out, I got sunburn on my cheeks. I forgot to apply sunscreen which if very important if using exfoliating product the night before. Advising others to learn from my mistake, if using this product, be sure to use sunscreen to protect your face if going outdoors. Overall, my skin did feel smooth and looked brighter the next day (minus my sunburn cheeks). I think safest for me is to use once a week in combination with my skin care routine and ensure sunscreen protection if to be exposed to sunlight.

Dealing with persistent acne in my late 20s remains an ongoing struggle. I've experimented with various physical exfoliating cleansers, but I've recently switched to one that relies solely on chemical exfoliants. Surprisingly, it generates a rich lather and is exceptionally gentle on the skin.

For years I'd battled stubborn dark spots left behind by acne, and even trying gentle products left my sensitive skin feeling raw. Rael's Miracle Clear Triple Acid Exfoliant was a game-changer. The triple acid blend gently buffed away the discoloration without irritating my skin. After just a few uses, my face felt smoother and my skin tone looked more even. It's like a mini facial at home, and in just three minutes! While I can't speak for everyone with sensitive skin, this product definitely delivered the brightening results I craved.
Rael Miracle Clear Brightening Triple Acid Face Exfoliant Gel-Serum is a gel-like serum that reduce flakiness and hydrates the skin. It moisturizes well and improve skin texture.

avis.titre: I recommend everyone to buy this product 🤤
avis.texte: The Miracle Clear Brightening Triple Acid Exfoliant is truly a game-changer in skincare. Its unique blend of triple acids - glycolic, lactic, and salicylic - work synergistically to exfoliate the skin, revealing a brighter and smoother complexion. This exfoliant effectively targets uneven skin tone, acne scars, and dullness, leaving the skin with a radiant glow. The formula is gentle yet powerful, suitable for all skin types. With consistent use, I've noticed a significant improvement in the overall texture and clarity of my skin. It's become an essential step in my skincare routine, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking to achieve a brighter, more even complexion.
